articles.title: Crypto custody firm Copper has potential buyers. But offers are way below its $500 million asking price
articles.snippet: Once valued at $2.5 billion, Copper was being marketed by investment bank Cantor Fitzgerald at around $500 million in May this year.

articles.title: MiCA revolutionised European crypto, and left Poland licking its wounds
articles.snippet: Many in Poland may look back at 2026 as the year European crypto finally grew up, and one of Poland’s brightest economic ambitions faded into darkness, writes Mateusz Kara, founder and CEO of Morphic Financial Group.

articles.title: Chainalysis-run sting targets child exploitation networks with aid of Binance, Coinbase
articles.snippet: 'Operation Lighthouse' went after child sex abuse materials, working with law enforcement to round up more than 14,000 investigative leads.

articles.title: A bitcoin short squeeze for the ages as futures open interest collapses
articles.snippet: Falling open interest and subdued funding rates suggest the rally remains structurally healthy.

articles.title: Monad proposes wallet upgrade that could survive lost keys and quantum attacks
articles.snippet: The Ethereum-compatible blockchain wants users to be able to replace the keys controlling an account without changing its address, opening the door to passkeys, recovery tools and post-quantum security.
